data.one_liner: A Dart library to generate, checksum, and validate Ethereum addresses.
data.what_it_does: It derives Ethereum addresses from public keys, converts addresses to checksummed formats using EIP-55, and validates existing Ethereum addresses.
use_when: You need to derive Ethereum addresses from public keys.
You need to convert addresses to EIP-55 checksum format.
You need to validate Ethereum address strings in your application.
avoid_when: You need a full Ethereum wallet or blockchain interaction client.
You are not working with Ethereum-compatible networks.
strengths: Simple and focused API for Ethereum address operations.
Supports address validation and EIP-55 checksum formatting.
weaknesses: Very narrow scope limited to address generation, checksums, and validation.
Not documented beyond basic address utilities.

alternatives.name: web3dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick web3dart if you need a full Ethereum blockchain client with wallet support and contract interaction rather than just address utilities.

alternatives.name: eip55
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick eip55 if you specifically need an alternative library for EIP-55 checksum encoding.
